description: Keeps the action pins current in this repo's own workflows AND in the synced templates under settings-sync/files/workflows/. The target repos' Dependabot bumps the same pins after a sync; keeping the templates current here stops the next sync from reverting them.

packageRules.description: One PR per week for all action bumps.

Our own reusable workflows: no release-age wait and no weekly window. The app repos move to a new release right away (by hand or the release PRs), so a template lagging behind would roll them back on the next sync.
